# Word documents for the DOCX import tests

These `.docx` files were made with Microsoft Word and are copied unchanged from the test data of
[mammoth](https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js) 1.13.0 (`test/test-data/`), which is BSD-2-Clause licensed:
see `LICENSE-mammoth`. They give the import tests documents written by Word itself, not only by this app's export.
Used by `packages/document-studio/src/import/word-files.test.ts`.
